The market faces mixed regulatory signals as the SEC aligns with CFTC guidance, while institutional interest remains evident with Strive’s $94.5 M Bitcoin purchase and Goldman Sachs channeling $100 B into crypto. Traders should watch for further price pressure and any catalyst from upcoming listings.
